name: sgc-proposal-engine
description: SDR-facing proposal-engine plugin. Six skills for the 13-step proposal pipeline, plus a sanitized knowledge base. Does not include the cost-to-serve / margin-floor / liquid-reserve internals — those are in the desk plugin.

author.name: SGC TECH AI / Scholarix Global Consultants FZCO

skills.name: approval-gate
skills.owner: SDR (read-only invocation); sole approver: Ali Asghar Teli Muhammad Iqbal Teli

skills.name: signature-dispatch
skills.owner: signature-handler (handler lives in the SRE repo, NOT bundled)

bump_required_for: Any rate, formula, gate, or clause change
Any redaction change (line set added or removed)
Any new skill or skill removal
versioning.sync_mechanism: Described in PUBLISHING.md at the repo root

forbidden_strings_check: ci/forbidden-strings.sh runs on every commit to this plugin's path. Failure blocks release.
secrets_check: ci/secrets-scan.sh runs on every commit to this plugin's path. Failure blocks release.
redaction_check: ci/diff-redacted-derivatives.py runs on every commit to this plugin's path. Failure blocks release.
